subject: Machine Learning
syllabus: Need of Classification, Types of Classification (Binary and Multiclass), Binary-vs-Multiclass Classification, Balanced and Imbalanced Classification Problems.
Linear Classification model, Performance Evaluation: Confusion Matrix, Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F measures.
One-vs-One and One-vs-All classification techniques, Performance Evaluation: Confusion Matrix, Per Class Precision, Per Class Recall.
K Nearest Neighbor, Linear Support Vector Machines (SVM): Introduction, Soft Margin SVM, Kernel functions: Radial Basis Kernel, Gaussian, Polynomial, Sigmoid.
